title: Sehra may paara
body:
sehra mein paara paara naushaah e karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
maula hassan ka sam se tukde jigar hua tha
ibne hassan ka ran mein tukde badan hua hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime mein laash aayi ibne hassan ki jis dam
kya guzri ek dulhan par allah jaanta hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
<<DIVIDER>>
masnad pe laash rakh kar bole shahe zaman ye
zainab dulhan ko lao dulha bhi aagaya hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard o alam ka toofan kubra ki zindagi mein
shadi ke baad haye kuch pal mein aagaya hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh hai zuban par aankhein bata rahi hai
kubra ki zindagi mein kuch bhi nahi bacha hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
<<DIVIDER>>
kubra dulhan bani thi ab ho chuki hai bewa
ghoongat ke badle rukh par ashkon ki ek rida hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
<<DIVIDER>>
ya rab mujhe uthaale ab jee ke kya karun mai
ek ghamzada dulhan ke honton pe ye dua hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab tak hai zindagani guzregi aansuon mein
dil ki zameen pe aisa zakhmon ka ghar basa hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard o alam mein aisi doobi hai zindagani
kubra ke haal par ab har koi ro raha hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
<<DIVIDER>>
ehsaas ki siyaahi dil ke qalam mein bhar ke
ibne hassan ka nauha maine fida likha hai
kubra ki zindagi ka gulshan ujad chuka hai
sehra mein paara paara...
author: Mir Fida Ali
